title: Exposure
description: How far a workload can be reached.

internalReach.description: How far the network policies let the rest of the cluster reach the workload: its own namespace only, specific peers, several namespaces, or the whole cluster.

indirect.description: True when the workload is reachable, one hop away, from a workload that is exposed from outside.

widenedBy.description: What set the internal reach when it goes beyond the workload's namespace: a rule of a policy, or a reason without one, such as no policy in the namespace.

unseen.description: What the collector couldn't evaluate, sorted: AdminNetworkPolicy and CalicoNetworkPolicy, kinds of policy that the cluster serves and whose rules can let in what the network policies deny; IPBlock, a policy's peer that can hold any address; and UnknownParentRef, a route's parent of a kind that the collector doesn't read. What it names narrows no reach, and where it names any, the workload may be reached further than the evidence says.

exposed.description: True when something outside the cluster reaches the workload.

via.description: The objects that expose the workload, such as an Ingress or a Service.

kind.description: The kind of the object, such as NetworkPolicy, or Namespace for a namespace without a policy.

namespace.description: Empty for an object that has no namespace.

rule.description: The index of the object's ingress rule that set the reach, from 0. Absent where no one rule did.

reason.description: How the object set the reach.

namespace.description: Empty for an object that has no namespace.
